value.rationale: The exact strong p=2 norm of centered maximal averaging on natural diameter-two friendship networks resolves a concrete sharp-constant problem not covered by the two known extremal families, provides explicit extremizers and square-root branching growth. The proof isolates and resolves competing singleton/local/global ball choices rather than relying on numerical brute force.
